subject: Request: One-time extension + credit reinstatement for Northward Analytics
messages:

Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@northward.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 16:12:00 -0000
Subject: Trial ended — asking for a small re-credit while hiring pause resolves

Hi Vivek,

Hope you’re well — we ran a short pilot with Redwood in July-August and were very impressed with inference latency and the model quality. We planned to expand to a production POC in September, but an unexpected hiring freeze hit our ML team and the project was put on hold.

Our trial credits expired yesterday and access to the sandbox is now locked. We still need a small window to finish an internal eval once we can pull the team together (~2 weeks). Would Redwood consider a one-time reinstatement of $2,500 of trial credits and a 14-day extension on the sandbox so we can finish the evaluation?

I’ve attached a short summary of what we tested and a screenshot of the last usage graph. Happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Best,
Emily
Emily Santos
Head of ML Ops, Northward Analytics
attachments: northward-eval-summary.pdf (application/pdf), usage-screenshot.png (image/png)

Hi Emily — thanks for the context and the summary, it’s helpful.

Short answer: possibly. We typically evaluate reinstatements on a case-by-case basis and look for a clear path to a paid POC or expansion. A few quick asks so I can move this to approvals:

- Can you confirm the approximate monthly spend you expect if you move to a paid POC (ballpark USD)?
- Is there a concrete timeline for the resumed work (you said ~2 weeks — are you comfortable committing to finishing the eval within 14 days once credits are added?)
- Any security/compliance blockers we should be aware of for Private/Dedicated later?

I’m looping in Marissa (customer success) and Kimberly (sales ops) to help with a plan and pricing visibility. If everything looks plausible, I can seek a one-time credit allowance from our channel credit pool.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Thanks Vivek — answers below inline.

- Ballpark monthly spend for a POC: $6–8k/mo depending on model selection and concurrency needs.
- Timeline: yes — we expect hiring to re-open next week and the core eval can be completed within 10 business days once team capacity returns; we can commit to finishing within 14 calendar days of credits being reinstated.
- Security: we’re SOC 2 Type II compliant; we don’t plan to move to Private yet but may request a dedicated environment if the POC shows promise. No regulatory blockers at this stage.

We appreciate you escalating — a short pilot extension will make the decision obvious.

—Emily
